scope: FY2027 House HGAB 3rd-reading DA FMR projects tested against DPWH National Road Network polylines, including the published primary, secondary and tertiary functional classes.
method: Each printed HGAB FMR start/end coordinate was transformed from WGS84 to UTM zone 51N. The closest point from either endpoint to a DPWH National Road Network line segment was measured in metres. This classified network layer contains primary, secondary and tertiary functional classes. The separate FY2024/FY2025 DA FMR ArcGIS layers also carry route endpoints and are used in the venue-link review, not as farm polygons. Bands are ≤100 m, 100–500 m, 500 m–1 km and >1 km; proximity is not proof of a usable access connection.

farmCoverage.method: Distance from either printed source endpoint to 2021 class-40 cropland pixels; exact raster-derived polygon boundaries in UTM 51N. Display polygons simplified by 12 m. No-data cells remain unknown. Search tested within 1 km of both endpoints.
farmCoverage.limits: Class 40 describes annual herbaceous cropland; woody perennial crops may be tree/shrub cover. This dated satellite classification does not establish present farms, property boundaries, ownership, access or wrongdoing. Review includes intermediate distance combinations so all projects remain counted.
farmCoverage.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

gaaRoadAlignmentAudit.note: This audit covers the integrated budget line-item table only. Coordinate-bearing FY2027 HGAB DA FMR project records and FY2024/FY2025 DA FMR ArcGIS records are separate datasets.

limits: This layer is the DPWH national-road network; its primary/secondary/tertiary labels are functional classes within that network, not a separate local-road inventory.
It does not cover every local, barangay, farm, or private road.
Coordinates are printed FMR endpoints and may be approximate; straight-line endpoint proximity does not prove an access connection.

For question 2, DPWH National Road Network matches and routes explicitly named as national, circumferential, bypass or coastal are not treated as remote. A municipality match is a provisional remote-area proxy; routes with a city or unresolved endpoint stay out of the confirmed remote subset.

The visitor-venue join uses a 100 m buffer around straight-line segments reconstructed from available start/end coordinates. Route alignment, operating status, property ownership, and actual access remain unverified.

Class 40 describes annual herbaceous cropland; woody perennial crops may be tree/shrub cover. This dated satellite classification does not establish present farms, property boundaries, ownership, access or wrongdoing. Review includes intermediate distance combinations so all projects remain counted.
